title: 교육감 소속 지방공무원 인사교류 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Establishment and Composition of the Ministry of Education Personnel Exchange Council for Local Public Officials)
(1) The Ministry of Education Personnel Exchange Council for Local Public Officials (hereinafter referred to as the "Council") shall be established under the Minister of Education pursuant to the former part of Article 30-2 (1) of the Local Public Officials Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act"). <Amended on March 23, 2013>
(2) The Vice Minister of Education shall serve as chairperson of the Council (hereinafter referred to as the "chairperson"), and the vice-chairperson shall be a general-service public official belonging to the Senior Executive Service of the Ministry of Education appointed by the Minister of Education. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
(3) Members of the Council shall be chairpersons of the personnel committees established under the respective superintendents of education of Cities/Dos pursuant to Article 7 of the Act (where Personnel Committee No. 1 and Personnel Committee No. 2 are established, the chairperson of Personnel Committee No. 1).
